name: ally
for: put a service on the ab0t auth mesh: sign-in for its customers, permissions, a branded login page, drop-in widgets, users and teams, backend and consumer keys, connections to other services

hands_off_to.for: modelling who may do what inside the client's own app (relationships)

answers: which environment am I pointed at, and is it prod
is the billing or payment consumer key for service X live on env Y, and which tier does it hold
which credentials file holds the client id / org slug / service key for service X on env Y (path and field, never the value)
what does authsetup run step NN create and where
does my installed authsetup match the version these SOPs describe (VERSION)
who holds which of my service's platform permissions
dangerous_defaults: authsetup targets prod when no --env is given (except up, which asks)
a NEXT line printed when no target was chosen has no --env; pasted as is, it targets prod
the default credentials directory ~/.authmesh/<service>/ holds every environment, prod included

verified_against.authsetup: 0.5.27 (help, source, migration kits v0.5.23-to-v0.5.24 … v0.5.26-to-v0.5.27; sop_command_lint 0 offenders)
